title: Triker's Endermen
description: Now the enderman are better and more mysterious!
body:
With this resource pack, the caves will be much better, because the endermen have been updated! ✨
They have a new and beautiful texture, and now it doesn't look like a mess of black pixels, but like a creature from the end! 😈
![This is what Endermen look like now:](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d31f9f7a97d3b5acd598a2d6cbcf379dee69db3e_0.webp)
